headline: President Obama changed the rules for the White House Domestic Policy Council, which advises the President on issues at home.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12859, the 1993 order that created the Domestic Policy Council. The title does not say what the specific changes are. Any changes would apply to how this White House advisory group is set up or run.

who_it_affects.group: White House Domestic Policy Council staff and members
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules that set up and guide the council, though the title does not say how.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, February 5, 2009 (not stated in the title)
